single_model_rule: B1, B2, and B3 use the same frozen local model and generation options; B0 is deterministic and has no model call.

engineering: all temporal and lock checks pass
48 prediction rows are emitted with no transport or schema failure
every row contains a normalized six-label probability distribution
the observatory renders cutoff, hidden future, predictions, outcome, calibration, provenance, and cost
success_criteria.scientific: none: synthetic fixtures cannot establish a real-person prediction advantage

failure_policy: Any missing row, invalid probability contract, hash mismatch, or leakage violation invalidates the run. Do not retune after inspecting first-generation results; changes require a new experiment ID.
